a.content: GS1, HIBCC i ICCBBA smatraju se imenovanim subjektima za dodjelu sve dok Komisija, u skladu s člankom 33. stavkom 7., ne imenuje subjekte za dodjelu.
a.source: 12. GS1, HIBCC i ICCBBA smatraju se imenovanim subjektima za dodjelu sve dok Komisija, u skladu s člankom 33. stavkom 7., ne imenuje subjekte za dodjelu.

b.content: Until the Commission has designated issuing entities pursuant to Article 27(2), GS1, HIBCC and ICCBBA shall be considered to be designated issuing entities.
b.source: 12. Until the Commission has designated, pursuant to Article 27(2), issuing entities, GS1, HIBCC and ICCBBA shall be considered to be designated issuing entities.

notes: The second genuine divergence between the two authentic language versions of Regulation (EU) 2017/745, and it was found rather than constructed. Article 120(12) points at Article 27(2) in English and at Article 33(7) in Croatian: a different article AND a different paragraph, in a provision about who may issue unique device identifiers. Same subject, same slot, both current, neither superseding the other.
